name: Robert Ley
role: Head of the German Labor Front (DAF) and Reich Organization Leader of the NSDAP (1933–1945)
summary: Nazi labour and party organiser who abolished the independent trade unions and led the DAF; his speeches and pamphlets are racist, antisemitic, anti-democratic and Führer-centred.

unions-good.rationale: He abolished the democratic unions and replaced them with the DAF, which served the regime.

strong-leader.rationale: He writes that a leader must emerge to win others by faith and says the Führer is always right.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: He calls the League of Nations a Jewish triumph and "ethnic mush" and says such conferences are a waste of time.

nation-first.rationale: He sets the national against the international and rejects talk between many states.

one-party-rule.rationale: As DAF and party organisation head he built the Nazi one-party state (Britannica: unions abolished, DAF built for the regime).

democracy-best.rationale: He mocks democracy and parliaments as Jewish instruments and approves the Führer replacing them.

war-builds-character.rationale: In 1945 he praises battle and bitter fanaticism, courage and loyalty as what wins, and calls the one who avoids battle a coward.

ethnic-nation.rationale: He defines the nation as a community of common nature and race.

class-struggle-history.rationale: He says the Jew diverted mass dissatisfaction into class parties against the national leadership.

duties-before-rights.rationale: He says either the individual lives with the nation or he perishes alone.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: He condemns proletarian internationalism and Marxism as Jewish world domination.

hereditarian-race.rationale: He bases National Socialism on the natural laws of race and inheritance and ascribes virtues and abilities to race.

national-rebirth.rationale: He says Germany has been born anew and the German is an entirely different person.

territorial-expansion.rationale: In 1937 he says "We must have new space... We are a people without space", and ties social measures to it.

universal-morality.rationale: He rejects universalism as Jewish and ties ethical laws to a racial community.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: He says the Jew can never build a state from chaos.

workplace-democracy.rationale: He describes the factory as leader and retinue, with the plant leader commanding and the Werkschar as party shock troops.

class-collaboration.rationale: He says employer and worker are to march in step with no distinction, and under National Socialism each is a good comrade.

workers-nation.rationale: He calls the slogan of international solidarity of the working class the greatest betrayal of the German worker.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: He describes racial mixing as the origin of the Jewish "parasite" and praises the "pure races"; he does not address marriages directly.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: He ridicules "All who have a human face are equal" as a Jewish lie.

population-transfer.rationale: He thanks God that most of German Jewry emigrated under Nazi pressure, but does not state a right to expel.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: He says one nation must rise above the others, and that fighting without pause is the first principle of success.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: He reports to Hitler that the DAF secured peace in the factories so that strikes are out of the question.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: He ranks languages and races by value and calls the German language the most beautiful.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: He defines the nation by blood and race, which is not a rule on citizenship at birth.

leader-cult.rationale: His 1936 speech makes belief in the Führer a creed ("The Führer is always right").

minority-conspiracy.rationale: In the 1941 pamphlet he says the Jew secretly works to destroy nations through capital, Marxism and Freemasonry, aiming at world domination.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: He attacks both capitalism and Marxism as two Jewish international masses.

suppress-opposition.rationale: He says the Führer ruthlessly ended the parties and unions and destroyed each "bacterium" in the people.

independent-unions.rationale: As DAF head he abolished the independent unions.

racial-pride.rationale: He calls the German the expression of the Nordic race and its pure-raced strength, and says the worker's racial instinct has awakened.

arms-reduction.rationale: He condemns Weimar Germany for disarming "to the last trouser button".

collective-bargaining.rationale: Britannica: he abolished the democratic unions; his own report says union and employer associations had to be smashed.

sacred-nation.rationale: He says the nation is a community of blood and fate; the individual lives with it or perishes alone.

race-social-construct.rationale: He treats race as a biological fact and the basis of nation, language and ethics.

notes: Evidence is mostly Ley's own propaganda from 1936–45 (words) plus Britannica for the record. Statements on social, moral, ecological and technology questions found no position and are null.
